title: Pizza toppings
instruction: Tell the customer how many toppings you have, ask which one they'd like, and check whether it's on the list.
hint: x in my_list is True if x is somewhere in the list.

blocks.code: choice = input("Which topping would you like? ")
print(f"Sorry, we have run out of {choice}.")

expectedOutput: Which topping would you like? mushroom
